name: Milford Road
description: Te Anau to Milford Sound through Fiordland: the Eglinton Valley, the Homer Tunnel and switchbacks down the Cleddau to the fiord

name: Crown Range Road
description: New Zealand's highest main road, from Arrowtown up the zigzag over the Crown Range through Cardrona to Wānaka

name: Glenorchy Road
description: Along the shore of Lake Wakatipu from Queenstown to Glenorchy, under the peaks of Mount Aspiring country

name: Haast Pass
description: Wānaka past Lakes Hāwea and Wānaka, over the Haast Pass and down past the Blue Pools and waterfalls to the West Coast

name: Lindis Pass
description: Tussock-covered pass between the Mackenzie Basin and Central Otago, one of the South Island's great open roads

name: Aoraki / Mount Cook Road
description: Along turquoise Lake Pukaki straight at Aoraki / Mount Cook, ending at the village under New Zealand's highest peak

name: Arthur's Pass
description: The Great Alpine Highway from Christchurch over the Southern Alps, past Castle Hill and over the Otira Viaduct to Greymouth

name: Lewis Pass
description: Beech forest crossing of the Southern Alps from Hanmer Springs to Reefton, the quieter alternative to Arthur's Pass

name: Great Coast Road
description: Westport to Greymouth along the wild Tasman coast past the Pancake Rocks at Punakaiki

name: Kaikōura Coast
description: State Highway 1 between the Seaward Kaikōura Range and the sea, with seal colonies and whale watching at Kaikōura

name: Tākaka Hill
description: Twisting marble-hill climb between Motueka and Golden Bay, with views over Tasman Bay

name: Queen Charlotte Drive
description: Winding coastal road from Picton to Havelock above the bays of the Marlborough Sounds

name: Southern Scenic Route (The Catlins)
description: Dunedin to Invercargill through the Catlins: waterfalls, petrified forest at Curio Bay and wild southern beaches

name: Summit Road and Akaroa (Banks Peninsula)
description: Christchurch over the old volcano of Banks Peninsula to the French-settled harbour town of Akaroa

name: Coromandel Loop
description: Around the Coromandel Peninsula: the Thames coast, Coromandel town, and the east-coast beaches near Cathedral Cove and Hot Water Beach

name: Desert Road
description: Across the high Rangipo Desert past the Tongariro volcanoes; often closed by snow in winter

name: Forgotten World Highway
description: Remote road from Taumarunui to Stratford through saddles, a one-lane tunnel and the self-declared Republic of Whangamōmona, partly gravel

name: East Cape Road
description: Around the East Cape from Ōpōtiki to Gisborne, through remote Māori communities and along wide empty beaches

name: Twin Coast Discovery Highway
description: Loop around Northland from Auckland through the Bay of Islands, the Hokianga and the giant kauri of Waipoua Forest

name: Thermal Explorer (Rotorua to Taupō)
description: Through the geothermal country between Rotorua and Taupō, past Wai-O-Tapu, Waimangu and the Huka Falls
